public_rationale: The resource-burden clause has qualitative support: a January 2024 survey identifies computational and memory costs as a major concern for transformer-based language models [e1]. The claim that these models lacked obvious, tangible mass-market use cases is contradicted under the contract's inclusion of consumer customer support: on February 27, 2024, Klarna reported 2.3 million assistant conversations in its first month, accounting for two-thirds of its customer-service chats [e2]. Klarna described support tasks including refunds and returns and reported customer satisfaction comparable to human agents, providing company-reported evidence of a practical consumer application at substantial scale before publication [e2].
limitations: The survey does not quantify monetary expense or establish high resource costs for every generative AI model [e1].
Klarna's usage and service results are company-reported and are not independently validated in the announcement [e2].
Klarna's projected profit improvement does not establish realized profitability [e2].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI models are expensive and compute-intensive and lack obvious mass-market use cases.

statement.excerpt: Generative AI models are expensive and compute-intensive without providing obvious, tangible mass-market use cases.

from_speaker: without providing obvious, tangible mass-market use cases
our_interpretation: I assess the resource-burden and use-case clauses separately.
I use 2024-01-01 through 2024-03-18 as the current reporting window because no period is named.
The ordinary reading of a tangible mass-market use case includes a useful consumer service delivered at substantial scale, including customer support.
Usage alone is insufficient; the application must perform an identifiable practical task.
The cost clause is a qualitative statement about model resources, not a specified company's financial result.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes substantial computational and financial resource demands, while representative deployment evidence establishes the absence of useful applications serving a broad market.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented practical application serving a broad market contradicts the absence clause. Evidence of low resource demands would separately contradict the resource clause.
